arStrings.szText:
Your Skills launch {c_important}Wave of Woe{/c} when they deal damage, dealing an additional {c_random}{SF_9}{/c} Shadow damage then bouncing {if:SF_2}at least {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} times {/if}between Nearby monsters of the same Family. {if:SF_2}These bounces may target the same enemy multiple times.

Every time it bounces, {c_important}Wave of Woe{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.{/if}
Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier III and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
{c_important}Wave of Woe{/c} now always bounces at least {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} times, dealing {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage each time.
